mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lung and body routes was most worthwhile: the continuous path made the jobs of both heart sides clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the left valves repeated the right-side actions, and the description wrongly seemed to leave the already fitted chamber valve gap pale.

surprise.text: The heart muscle needs its own blood vessels; blood inside the chambers cannot supply all of it.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though several later choices were the only offered combinations rather than decisions I could reason between.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the circulation connects to other body systems, though I hope for more meaningful choices and fewer repeated fittings.
